title: 第19章 她有圣人血脉第20章 高阶妖兽赤甲狮
slug: 太古封神第1516章直接镇压
lines: 虽然乾素素是楚王府后人，但是她是侍女生出的庶出，从小就不被待见，要不是运气好的话早就死了。
母亲还活着的时候，乾素素过的还好一些，至少有地方住和有一口饭吃。
母亲死后。
楚王府掌管后院的王妃就收回了母亲的住处，并将她赶到一座老旧的院子里面。
那个地方和下人住的差不多。
乾素素无依无靠。
不但楚王府的同辈欺负她，就连下人都看不起她。
除去母亲之外，从来没人对她好过。
秦云是第一个对她好的人。
玄天老祖站在一旁静静地看着，他没有说话。
庶出的下场。
他比任何人都清楚。
乾素素还算运气好的，至少活到了现在，很多庶出刚出世就死了，而且大多死得不明不白。
秦云不由一阵心酸，连忙说道：“既然你跟了我，那么你放心，只要我在，就不允许有人欺负你了。”
“谢谢秦云哥哥……”
乾素素激动起来，她的额头突然闪过一道淡淡的特殊印纹。
这时，秦云突然感觉到四周变冷了下来。
怎么回事？
四周怎么变冷了？
“是她的圣人血脉要觉醒了，刚刚因为情绪激动，引出了一点圣人血脉的力量。”
银发女子对秦云说道：“她有圣人血脉，你可以培养她，引发出圣人血脉之力加快太古封神殿的力量恢复。”
“只要培养得当，她释放的圣人血脉之力越多，太古封神殿恢复的力量就越快，应该用不了太久就可以重塑无上至尊神体的第二部分了。”
吞噬神脉的强大，秦云深有体会。
无上至尊神体的第二部分，肯定不比吞噬神脉弱。
秦云自然希望更快重塑。
不过，秦云还是有些担心，因为银发女子所说的培养，感觉就像是要将乾素素培养成鼎炉一样。
乾素素已经够可怜了，如果再被当成鼎炉汲取圣人之血的话，秦云还真下不去手。
银发女子看穿了秦云的想法，哼声道：“太古封神殿不是你想象的那种东西，它根本不需要汲取她的圣人血脉之力。
“而是以圣人血脉之力为引，就像是火种一样，以火种点燃，然后再借助火种之力来恢复。”
“你以为，太古封神殿会看得上她那点圣人血脉？”
银发女子最后的语气充斥着不屑。
银发女子这么说，秦云就放心了。
“激发圣人血脉之法，我现在就传给你，你等下传给她修炼，可以加快她的圣人血脉觉醒。”
银发女子说道。
秦云点了点头
content_en:
Although Qian Susu is a descendant of the Chu Palace, she was the daughter of a maid and was not treated since she was a child. If she were not lucky, she would have died long ago.
When her mother was still alive, Qian Susu's life was better. At least she had a place to live and food to eat.
After mother died.
The princess in charge of the backyard of the Chu Palace took back her mother's residence and drove her into an old courtyard.
That place is similar to where servants live.
Qian Susu is helpless.
Not only did her peers in Prince Chu's palace bully her, but even the servants looked down on her.
Except for her mother, no one has ever been kind to her.
Qin Yun was the first person to treat her well.
Ancestor Xuantian stood aside and watched quietly, without speaking.
The fate of a concubine.
He knows better than anyone.
Qian Susu is quite lucky, at least she has survived until now. Many concubines died right after they were born, and most of them died in unknown ways.
Qin Yun couldn't help feeling sad, and said quickly: "Since you followed me, don't worry, as long as I am here, no one will be allowed to bully you."
"Thank you, brother Qin Yun..."
Qian Susu became excited, and a faint special mark suddenly flashed across her forehead.
At this time, Qin Yun suddenly felt that the surrounding area had become colder.
What's going on?
Why is it getting cold around here?
"It's her saint bloodline that is about to awaken. Just now, because of her excitement, she elicited a little bit of the saint's bloodline power."
The silver-haired woman said to Qin Yun: "She has the blood of a saint. You can cultivate her and induce the power of the saint's blood to speed up the recovery of the power of the Ancient Sealed Temple."
"As long as she is properly cultivated, the more power of the saint's bloodline she releases, the faster the power of the Ancient Sealed Temple will be restored. It shouldn't take too long to reshape the second part of the Supreme Divine Body."
Qin Yun deeply understands the power of Devouring Divine Veins.
The second part of the Supreme Divine Body is certainly no weaker than the Devouring Divine Veins.
Qin Yun naturally hopes to reshape it faster.
However, Qin Yun was still a little worried, because the cultivation mentioned by the silver-haired woman felt like cultivating Qian Susu into a cauldron.
Qian Susu is already pitiful enough. If he is used as a cauldron to absorb the saint's blood again, Qin Yun really won't be able to do it.
The silver-haired woman saw through Qin Yun's thoughts and hummed: "The Ancient Sealed Temple is not what you think, it does not need to absorb the power of her saint's bloodline.
“Rather, it is guided by the power of the saint’s bloodline, just like a fire, ignited by the fire, and then restored with the help of the power of the fire. "
"Do you think that the Taigu Temple will value her saintly blood? "
The silver-haired woman's final tone was full of disdain.
When the silver-haired woman said this, Qin Yun felt relieved.
"I will teach you the method of stimulating the saint's bloodline now, and you can pass it on to her later to practice, which will speed up the awakening of her saint's bloodline. "
The silver-haired woman said.
Qin Yun nodded
